Introduction
These procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of A 32 relay.
It is recommended this procedure be carried out an yearly bases the first 
preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates required 
prior to testing.
The first draft is imitated 
and tested by Eng. Mostafa Hasas, accepted by general director Eng. 
Farag Abo Yousef, Approved by Eng. Abd ElMohsen Abd ElKhafar.
